# BasketIQ Repo Standard — structure, secrets and onboarding

Every repo under the `BasketIQ` GitHub org follows the same skeleton. This rule defines that skeleton and how a new repo joins it. For the step-by-step procedure, use the `repo-onboarding` skill (`basketiq-wow/skills/repo-onboarding/`).

## 1. Repo creation

- Create with `gh` from Local: `gh repo create BasketIQ/<repo> --private` (all BasketIQ repos are private unless explicitly public).
- Clone into the workspace root: `/Users/jjdelcampo/projects/basketiq/<repo>`.
- Register the repo in `basketiq-wow/docs/sdlc/repos-mapping.md` — owner agent, purpose, local port (if it serves), staging URL (if deployed).

## 2. Standard repo anatomy

Every repo carries:

| Item | Source | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `AGENTS.md` / `CLAUDE.md` | generated by `basket setup` / `basket sync` | pointer docs — never hand-edit |
| `.devin/rules/`, `.windsurf/rules/`, `.cursor/rules/` | generated by `basket sync` | materialized from `basketiq-wow/rules/` |
| `.devin/skills/` | generated by `basket sync` | materialized from `basketiq-wow/skills/` |
| `.codeiumignore` | copy of `basketiq-wow/templates/.codeiumignore` | bounds the IDE index/RAM |
| `docs/` | authored | technical memory lives here (rule 04) |
| `.github/workflows/` | authored | CI/deploy; must use `pick-runner` (rule 06) |
| `.github/actions/` | vendored verbatim from `basketiq-wow/.github/actions/` | `pick-runner`, `setup-self-hosted-env` — only if the repo has workflows |

Repo-specific rules are authored in `basketiq-wow/rules/` with the right `trigger`/`scope` — never as one-off files inside the repo.

## 3. Org-level secrets and variables (not per-repo)

Configured once at the `BasketIQ` org level and inherited by every repo:

| Kind | Name | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| secret | `RUNNER_PICK_PAT` | PAT with *Self-hosted runners: Read* — lets `pick-runner` query runner state |
| variable | `DEVELOPMENT_RUNNER_NAME` | name of the `development` self-hosted runner |
| variable | `INTEGRATION2_RUNNER_NAME` | name of the `integration2` self-hosted runner |
| secret (optional) | `NETDATA_CLOUD_API_TOKEN` | CPU circuit-breaker for `pick-runner` |
| variable (optional) | `NETDATA_CLOUD_SPACE_ID`, `NETDATA_CLOUD_ROOM_ID`, `NETDATA_NODE_DEVELOPMENT`, `NETDATA_NODE_INTEGRATION2` | circuit-breaker node mapping |

A repo never defines its own runner PAT — missing `RUNNER_PICK_PAT` simply makes `pick-runner` fall back to `ubuntu-latest`.

## 4. Per-repo configuration

Declared per repo (environment `staging`/`production` or repo level, as each workflow expects):

| Name | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `GCP_BIQ_WIF_PROVIDER`, `GCP_DEPLOYER_SA` | Workload Identity Federation — keyless GCP auth from Actions |
| `GCP_PROJECT_ID`, `GCP_AR_REPO`, `GCP_RUN_SERVICE` | target project, Artifact Registry repo, Cloud Run service name |
| `STAGING_BASIC_AUTH_USER`, `STAGING_BASIC_AUTH_PASSWORD` | basic-auth gate on staging services |

Prefer WIF over service-account JSON keys everywhere (rule 01).

## 5. CI wiring

- Any repo with GitHub Actions wires the `pick-runner` pattern from day 1 (rule 06): vendored actions, `pick` job, inline `runs-on`, `setup-self-hosted-env` before `setup-node`/`setup-python`.
- `concurrency: { group: '${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}', cancel-in-progress: true }` on `pull_request`-triggered workflows.
- Deployable repos deploy only via workflows (rule 00 § No Direct Production Deployments); staging deploys follow the repo's governed workflow (mobile suite: rule 07).

## 6. Onboarding checklist (summary)

1. `gh repo create` + clone under the workspace root.
2. Row in `docs/sdlc/repos-mapping.md` (owner, port, staging URL).
3. `basket setup --ide devin --root <repo>` then `basket sync` — materializes rules/skills; never hand-edit generated files.
4. Copy `templates/.codeiumignore` → `<repo>/.codeiumignore`.
5. Vendor `.github/actions/` + wire `pick-runner` if the repo has workflows.
6. Declare per-repo secrets/vars if it deploys.
7. Record the decision in the repo's `docs/` (rule 04) and in the closing handoff.

## Forbidden

- Hand-editing files generated by `basket sync` (`.devin/rules/`, `AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, `.windsurf/`, `.cursor/`).
- Defining repo-level runner credentials instead of using org secrets/vars.
- Creating a repo outside the `BasketIQ` org or outside the workspace root.
- Skipping the `repos-mapping.md` registration.
